finalText:
**Redis died at 02:14:07 and never came back.**

`10.0.0.12:6379` refused every connect, starting at [logs/app.log:182](logs/app.log:182). All 13 reconnect tries failed. Cache fell back to direct store reads. That caused 173 timeouts and a growing queue. Depth passed the 500 cap at 02:29:12. `worker-2` hit heap OOM at 02:31:44. Supervisor killed `api` at 02:31:52. No request succeeded after 02:14:03.

Next: find why Redis at `10.0.0.12` went down.
